items.text: "unsaved" badge stuck on — the header pill could show unsaved right after opening Config, before you touched anything. A CSS selector (.unsaved-badge:not([hidden])) matched almost always and overrode the hidden state. The badge now only appears through the same is-visible class the dirty-tracking logic already toggles, so it matches the real save state.
Go toolchain version — go.mod now declares go 1.24 (was 1.21) to match testing.Chdir already used across the test suite. go vet ./... no longer fails with testing.Chdir requires go1.24 or later.
Cache-bust — whats-new-v95 data version and 2026.06-dashboard-release-v74 dashboard release token.
